config.title: TTS Reader
config.provider.description: TTS provider. edge-tts = Microsoft Edge TTS (free, no key). openai = OpenAI TTS API. google = Google Cloud TTS. custom = user-defined HTTP endpoint.
config.voice.description: TTS voice name. Format depends on provider: Edge TTS (en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural), OpenAI (alloy/nova/echo), Google (en-US-Standard-A).
config.rate.description: Speaking rate as a percentage offset, e.g. -20%, +0%, +25%.
config.maxSegmentChars.description: Maximum characters per TTS request segment. Edge TTS handles ~200-300 chars best; longer text is split at sentence/punctuation boundaries.
config.minSegmentChars.description: Minimum characters to accumulate before sending a segment. Short fragments are merged with neighbors.
config.segmentMode.description: Segmentation strategy. smart = sentence-aware with length control (recommended). sentence = split only on sentence boundaries. paragraph = split on blank lines/paragraphs.
config.preloadSegments.description: Number of segments to synthesize ahead of the currently-playing one (0 = synthesize on demand).
config.playbackRate.description: Client-side playback speed multiplier (independent of TTS 'rate'). 1.0 = normal.
config.proxyUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL for the Edge TTS API, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890. Leave empty for direct connection.
config.apiUrl.description: TTS API endpoint. For Edge TTS: wss:// URL. For OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1. For custom: your endpoint URL.
config.apiKey.description: API key for the TTS provider (OpenAI, Google, or custom). Not needed for Edge TTS.
config.model.description: TTS model name (OpenAI only). E.g. tts-1, tts-1-hd.
config.trustedClientToken.description: TrustedClientToken query parameter for the Edge TTS API. Override if your endpoint requires a different token.
